baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural noun ٱلصُّحُفُ and passive نُشِرَتْ join written sheets to an event of opening and spatial exposure.
baseline_models.mechanism: Stored writing changes state: closed, folded, or inaccessible records are laid out so that their contents become inspectable. The passive leaves the opener unstated and makes universal exposure, rather than an owner's voluntary disclosure, the center of the scene.

activation_trace.role: Written sheets supply the durable record whose previously contained contents can become evidence.
Opening, spreading, and branching out supply the record's transition from enclosure to full inspectability.

changed_reading.after: A closed documentary store is forcibly converted into an exposed field of evidence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The written-sheet sense of صحف is acted on by a نشر branch that specifically includes an open, unsealed document.
baseline_models.mechanism: The event is communicative as well as physical: what was sealed or restricted is promulgated. Spreading the sheets therefore makes their claims public and answerable, like issuing an authoritative document rather than merely flattening paper.

activation_trace.role: The written sheet supplies a transmissible document rather than an anonymous flat object.
The open written document supplies unsealing and publication as the functional force of the passive verb.

changed_reading.after: Documents are unsealed into public force: their contents are issued, not merely displayed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The صحف inventory includes sheets collected into a codex, while نشر includes opening and branching outward.
baseline_models.mechanism: A gathered archive loses its compact unity and fans into separately visible leaves. The plural thus carries a distributive change: records that could be handled as one bound object become individually addressable units.

activation_trace.role: Collected sheets in a codex supply the initial compact and bounded archival state.
Spreading with branching supplies the separation of a gathered archive into accessible leaves.

changed_reading.before: Books or records are opened as wholes.
changed_reading.after: A consolidated archive is fanned apart until every constituent leaf is separately encounterable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive نُشِرَتْ can activate the نشر branch of revival while its subject remains the written صحف.
baseline_models.mechanism: The records cross from inert storage into operative presence. Their contents do not simply sit before an observer; they acquire the force of living testimony capable of acting in the present scene.

activation_trace.role: Written sheets anchor the activation in records rather than transferring it to resurrected bodies.
Revival after death supplies the strange but anchored shift from inert inscription to active testimony.

changed_reading.before: Past facts are passively displayed in writing.
changed_reading.after: The written past is reanimated as a present actor and witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence rolls the sun inward, whereas the focus spreads documents outward. These inverse material motions make the sheets a counter-event: as the familiar source of visibility is wrapped and compacted, another medium of disclosure is unfolded.

activation_trace.role: Collected sheets supply a compact documentary body capable of being opened against the context's rolling motion.
Outward opening and spreading supply one pole of the roll-unroll reversal.
Turning, wrapping, and gathering parts together supply the opposed inward compression of the sun.

structural_cues: 81:1 and 81:10 share the إذا + definite noun + passive perfect frame, making their opposed motions formally comparable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wrapping at 81:1 and spreading at 81:10; I infer an antithetical transfer of visibility from sun to document. A live alternative is that both are coordinate transformations without a designed counter-motion.

changed_reading.before: Records are opened within a list of end-time events.
changed_reading.after: Documentary disclosure opens precisely as cosmic illumination is rolled shut.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context couples gathering toward a destination with joining each thing to a counterpart or class. Against those motions, the sheets' fanning is not random dispersal: an archive is decomposed so that each record can be reassociated with the life, person, or kind to which it corresponds.

activation_trace.role: The codex-like collection supplies an archive that can be decomposed into constituent dossiers.
Branching spread supplies the outward distribution needed before records can be individually matched.
Driving a group together toward one destination supplies the context's countervailing collection pressure.
Making one thing the counterpart of another supplies the reassignment step after the archive is spread.

structural_cues: The repeated passive clauses move collectives through gathering, pairing, and spreading without naming human agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, pairing, a collected-sheet branch, and branching spread; I infer that separated sheets are correlated back to subjects. They could instead remain one collective revelation with no person-by-person allocation.

changed_reading.after: The archive fans into dossiers so each record can be joined to its corresponding subject.

context_deltas.mechanism: Question, alleged offense, and killing form a compact judicial case immediately before the sheets open. The focus becomes the institutional reversal of suppression: what was buried without a hearing is restored to an evidentiary forum in which the charge and the killing can be examined.

activation_trace.role: Written sheets supply the case record that can preserve what violence attempted to suppress.
An open written document supplies the public reopening of the case.
Question and demand supply the hearing in which the suppressed event is made answerable.
Guilt or offense supplies the disputed legal ground whose absence indicts the killing.
Taking life supplies the irreversible act that the opened record nevertheless returns to adjudication.

structural_cues: The branchless و ء د occurrence at 81:8 supplies only the buried-victim position; no branch identity is assigned to it.
The question at 81:8, its ground at 81:9, and the document-opening at 81:10 form a hearing-to-record sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a buried victim structurally, a question, guilt, killing, and opened writing; I infer that the sheets function as the reopened case file. A live alternative is that the sheets concern all deeds generally and are only juxtaposed with this one case.

changed_reading.before: General records of deeds are displayed.
changed_reading.after: A silenced case is reopened, and documentary publicity reverses the killer's attempted erasure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The page and the sky become parallel covered surfaces. Spreading the sheets and stripping the sky remove two layers of concealment, so documentary disclosure participates in a wider collapse of envelopes rather than standing as a narrowly clerical event.

activation_trace.role: Flat spread and breadth supply the page as a surface whose full face can be exposed.
Opening and spreading supply removal of the page's folded or covered state.
Taking away a cover and revealing what was hidden supplies the adjacent cosmic analogue for opening the sheets.

structural_cues: 81:10 and 81:11 are adjacent passive إذا clauses, first transforming sheets and then the sky.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a broad opened surface and an adjacent removal of covering; I infer that page and sky share an exposure mechanism. The alternative is simple sequence with no cross-surface analogy.

changed_reading.after: The opened page is one layer in a world whose covering surfaces are being removed.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the documents open, fire is activated, the garden is driven near, and a self knows what it has made present. This sequence turns the sheet from a retrospective container into an executable record: disclosure and realized consequence become successive states of one adjudicative process.

activation_trace.role: Written sheets supply the durable account from which consequences can be read and enacted.
The open document supplies the transition from stored account to operative instrument.
Igniting fire supplies one consequence becoming active rather than remaining merely described.
An impulsion into nearness supplies the other consequence crossing from remote promise to present availability.
Something becoming uncovered to the knower supplies the self's recognition when the record is opened.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness supply the conversion of past action into something confronting the self now.

structural_cues: The ordered passives at 81:10-13 culminate in the active cognition clause at 81:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opened writing, activated outcomes, nearness, knowledge, and presence; I infer a document-to-execution arrow. The materially live alternative is that the clauses are coordinate signs and the record only reports consequences already realized elsewhere.

changed_reading.after: Opening the record helps make its consequences present and personally knowable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Retreat into hiding is followed by dawn's opening breath. Within that concealment-reemergence cycle, spreading the sheets is a timed phase transition into legibility: hidden content comes out and occupies a widening field, rather than merely being placed on a table.

activation_trace.role: Opening and outward spread supply the documentary emergence phase.
Retreat into concealment or delay supplies the hidden phase against which the sheets emerge.
Entering a shelter supplies enclosure as a recurrent state rather than a permanent disappearance.
The first light of day supplies the temporal threshold into renewed visibility.
The opening of dawn like a breath supplies gradual expansion into visible space.

structural_cues: The oath sequence at 81:15-18 moves from retreat and shelter through a boundary of darkness into breathing morning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, shelter, morning, and an opening breath; I align them with the focus verb as a temporal legibility cycle. The alternative is that the oath images certify the later message without modifying how the sheets open.

changed_reading.after: Their legibility arrives like dawn: hidden inscription expands into a new regime of visibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence identifies a saying, a messenger, trustworthiness, eyewitness access, clear disclosure, hidden content, and non-withholding. Those cues convert the focus from anonymous publication into authenticated dissemination with provenance: an opened document is credible because its transmission path is named and tested.

activation_trace.role: Written sheets supply the durable public endpoint of a transmitted message.
The unsealed open document supplies publication rather than private custody.
Uttered speech supplies the content that passes into communicable form.
Messenger and message supply an identified transmission link rather than spontaneous inscription.
Security and trust supply the reliability condition for receiving the disseminated content.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies direct witness within the provenance chain.
Making meaning clear through speech or sign supplies intelligibility after transmission.
Content hidden from eyes supplies what publication moves across the visibility boundary.
Withholding or hoarding supplies the blocked transmission explicitly negated by the context.

structural_cues: 81:19-24 shifts from assertion of source through credentials and witness to a denial of restricted disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech, messenger, trust, sight, clarification, hidden content, and non-withholding; I organize them as provenance for the opened sheets. A live alternative is that these certify only oral recitation and do not reactivate the documentary focus.

changed_reading.before: The pages are made public, but their source is unspecified.
changed_reading.after: The pages are an authenticated publication whose chain of transmission and refusal of secrecy are part of their openness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement asks about direction, identifies a reminder, opens a field of willing, and names straightness. The published sheet therefore has prospective force alongside retrospective accounting: it recalls a claim and places a route before a reader who can orient toward it.

activation_trace.role: The written sheet supplies a durable object that can address conduct, not only preserve the past.
Open publication supplies broad availability of the orienting document.
A path, place, or way supplies the directional problem posed to the addressee.
A reminder that actively prompts recollection supplies the document's prospective address.
Will directed toward a thing supplies the addressee's live response rather than passive observation.
Straightness, balance, and levelness supply the route toward which the open reminder reorients.

structural_cues: The rhetorical question at 81:26 is answered by universal reminder at 81:27 and a purpose clause for willing straightness at 81:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direction, reminder, willing, and straightness; I infer that the opened written medium mediates their sequence. The alternative is that the focus sheets are only retrospective records while a separate oral reminder performs the guidance.

changed_reading.before: The sheets disclose a completed past.
changed_reading.after: The open record also addresses the present reader, making a remembered claim available as a path toward straightness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sheets can be universally open without becoming autonomously effective. The final nesting of human willing inside divine willing, under lordship, bounds the guidance model: publication supplies access and address, while the realization of response remains governed beyond the document itself.

activation_trace.role: The open document supplies public availability whose efficacy is being delimited.
The repeated branch of will supplies nested agencies rather than a single reader-controlled response.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the governing frame around both publication and response.

structural_cues: The exceptive construction at 81:29 places one willing inside another after 81:28 has invited a willing response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies open publication, nested willing, and sovereignty; I infer a limit on documentary causation. An alternative is that 81:29 qualifies human willing generally without changing the force of the opened sheets.

changed_reading.before: Once published, the document itself is sufficient to produce straightness.
changed_reading.after: Publication makes response possible and accountable, but neither access nor willing operates as an autonomous cause.

It remains anchored in the focus through the broad surface of صحف and the opening action of نشر. Downstream prose should call it a material and split-root activation, not claim that sky lexically means an inscribed page.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The flat, broad face carried by صحف and its opening by نشر can receive the adjacent image of a covering stripped to expose marks.

activation_trace.role: Flat spread and breadth supply the readable surface or face in the material analogy.
Opening and spreading supply exposure of the full marked surface.
The non-dominant visible-mark branch supplies inscription-like traces on the exposed cosmic surface.
Stripping skin supplies the forceful removal of an outer hide so marks beneath become readable.

changed_reading.before: Paper pages are unfolded beside an unrelated stripped sky.
changed_reading.after: The world itself is handled like a marked hide: its covering is stripped and its broad face opened into legibility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is odd because it activates the non-dominant س ل ل inventory mapped from the context root س ء ل. It remains valid as an abductive extraction mechanism anchored in written sheets and their opening. It should be rendered as a split-root cue that suggests testimony being drawn out, never as the direct morphology of سُئِلَتْ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Written صحف acted on by the spreading verb can be imagined as leaves drawn one by one from a concealed store.

activation_trace.role: Written sheets supply the latent testimony that can be extracted into view.
Opening and branching outward supply the visible spread after extraction.
The non-dominant image of gently drawing something out from concealment supplies the testimonial extraction step.

changed_reading.before: The record is opened all at once.
changed_reading.after: Suppressed testimony is drawn out leaf by leaf and then spread where it can no longer remain hidden.

The model remains anchored in the focus's written and openly issued document, and the surrounding realized outcomes make valuation functionally coherent. It should be presented as a cross-domain ledger analogy, not as a lexical replacement for any surface word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The written, openly issued صحف can function as a ledger in which acts receive an operative valuation.

activation_trace.role: The written sheet supplies the ledger substrate on which valuation can be fixed.
The open document supplies public issuance of the resulting appraisal.
Market pricing supplies a scale on which recorded acts can be assigned consequential value.
Valuation and appraisal supply the act of assessing what the open ledger contains.

changed_reading.before: The pages inventory acts without transforming them.
changed_reading.after: The open pages operate as a public appraisal ledger in which acts acquire realized value and consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the technical صحف branch of misreading confused letters and turns an eschatological image into a provenance audit. It remains directly anchored in the focus root and is sharpened by the context's trusted source, rejected attribution, and rejection of conjecture about the hidden. Downstream prose should qualify it as a meta-textual activation, not reduce the verse to manuscript criticism.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The صحف inventory itself contains error arising from ambiguous written forms, while نشر makes the document open to inspection.

activation_trace.role: Misreading caused by confused written letters supplies the possibility of textual distortion that exposure can test.
The open written document supplies inspectability and comparison rather than sealed transmission.
Trust and security supply the positive provenance standard against which distortion is tested.
Saying what was not or falsely attributing it supplies the rejected provenance failure.
Conjectural speech about hidden matters supplies an unauthenticated alternative to documented disclosure.

changed_reading.before: Opening the pages only reveals their substantive contents.
changed_reading.after: Opening also exposes transmission errors and false attributions, allowing the record's provenance to be judged.

strongest_changes: The sun's inward wrapping makes the sheets' outward spread a transfer from cosmic visibility to documentary visibility.
The buried-victim question turns generic disclosure into the reopening of a suppressed judicial case.
The sequence through kindling, nearness, knowledge, and presence makes the record executable rather than merely descriptive.
The messenger, witness, clarity, hidden content, and non-withholding sequence recasts spread sheets as authenticated publication.
The final direction-reminder-will-straightness movement preserves a prospective guidance document beside the retrospective ledger.
summary.what_was_special: The two-word focus supports unusually different mechanisms without losing its anchors: material unrolling, archival decomposition, public issuance, revived testimony, judicial reopening, consequence execution, provenance control, and guidance. Split-root cues also produced live but contained readings of an inscribed cosmic skin, extracted testimony, and a valuation ledger.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus alone does not settle whether the sheets are personal records, revealed documents, a collective archive, or several of these at once.
The causal arrow from opened record to realized consequence is abductive; the ordered clauses can also be coordinate transformations.
The revival branch of نشر may mark active testimony or may be only resonance beside the direct opening sense.
Non-dominant split-root activations are structurally productive but must never be presented as direct etymologies of the source surfaces.
The guidance reading may reactivate the focus document, or the later reminder may operate through an independent oral channel.
